{{Short description|Norwegian chemist (born 1948)}}
'''Leiv Kristen Sydnes''' (born 9 July 1948) is a Norwegian chemist, specializing in [[organic chemistry]].

He was born in [[Haugesund]], and took his education at the [[University of Oslo]]. He has the [[dr.philos.]] degree from 1978. He was hired as an [[associate professor]] at the [[University of Tromsø]] in 1978, and was later promoted to professor. In 1993, he moved to the [[University of Bergen]]. He presided over the [[Norwegian Chemical Society]] from 1992 to 1996 and the [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry]] (IUPAC) from 2004 to 2005.<ref name="snl">{{cite encyclopedia |year=2007 |title=Sydnes, Leiv Kristen |encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]] |publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget |location= |url=https://snl.no/Leiv_K._Sydnes }}{{Dead link|date=February 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> He is a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27627|title=Gruppe 4: Kjemi|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=28 October 2009|archive-date=19 February 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120219071836/http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27627|url-status=dead}}</ref> and the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ntva.no/index.php?option=com_club&view=member&id=444%3Asydnes-leiv-kristen&Itemid=60|title=Medlemmer: SYDNES, Leiv Kristen|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=29 December 2013}}</ref>

Sydnes stood for election as rector of the University of Bergen in 2005, but lost the election to [[Sigmund Grønmo]]. In 2009, he applied for the position as rector of the [[Norwegian University of Science and Technology]];<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.universitetsavisa.no/ua_lesmer.php?kategori=nyheter&dokid=497040e66f0887.50442265|title=Navn på ekstern rektorkandidat kjent|last=Monsen|first=Tor H.|date=16 January 2009|work=Universitetsavisa|language=Norwegian|accessdate=30 January 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110723183650/http://www.universitetsavisa.no/ua_lesmer.php?kategori=nyheter&dokid=497040e66f0887.50442265|archive-date=23 July 2011|url-status=dead}}</ref> here the rectors are hired rather than elected.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.universitetsavisa.no/ua_lesmer.php?kategori=nyheter&dokid=4934f9c7b0bb23.72735600|title=- Eksterne søkere ikke velkomne|last=Monsen|first=Tor H.|date=2 December 2008|work=Universitetsavisa|language=Norwegian|accessdate=30 January 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110723183753/http://www.universitetsavisa.no/ua_lesmer.php?kategori=nyheter&dokid=4934f9c7b0bb23.72735600|archive-date=23 July 2011|url-status=dead}}</ref>
